_about: Files under library/ that the engine would resolve and a clean checkout lacks. Generated, do not hand-edit: node scripts/missing_assets.mjs > references/missing-assets.json. uses = styles, brand kits and example reels that name the asset (after `extends`) + engine code sites that name it (listed per file with a count, no line numbers, so the list only changes when a reference is added or removed). Styles named only through a family (whoosh/pop/impact) count for every variant. counts per kind: referenced = named by a style/reel/code (dangling ids included), catalogued_only = in a library manifest and named by nothing; dangling = named but no manifest entry, so no path. The engine-code sound scan is a heuristic (a line regex plus an exclusion list), so the code-site lists and the dangling sfx list are a strong hint, not exact.

resolution.sfx: build.mjs reads sfx/manifest.json; addSfx: id (a family pop/whoosh/impact picks its variants round-robin, VARIANTS) -> sfx/<manifest[id].file>; no entry or no file = skipped with a warning
resolution.music: build.mjs music (auto, fallback) and lib/motion.mjs buildMusic: id -> music/<manifest[id].file>; missing = fatal unless music.optional
resolution.art: build.mjs artAsset: key -> art/<key>.jpg (fatal when missing); resolveLayerImage for layer images (skipped when missing)
resolution.engraving: build.mjs objectPops (CONCEPTS) and lib/motion.mjs page scenes (paper / pageToCollage, collage, concept, stack icon, cutout): key -> engravings/png/<key>.png; lib/motion.mjs collage: engravings/bulge.png
resolution.object: lib/gadzhi.mjs gm-object / gm-nodes: name -> gm-objects/<name>.png (brain -> puzzle)
resolution.meme: build.mjs memeLib: id -> memes/<id>/meta.json (fatal when missing)
resolution.pack: build.mjs packClip: style `packs` on -> packs/<pack>/<kind>/*.mp4 (leaks, burns, 8mm-gate, 8mm-dust); pickBurn: openFlash.clip -> packs/<pack>/burns/<clip>. Absent = asset-free fallback
